bathAction.title: Leg up
bathAction.tooltip: Prop one foot up to reach between the legs. Half a minute. Needs two legs.

description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(prop)] one foot up and [npc.verb(open)] the way to what sitting only half reached. Water runs down the raised [npc.leg] and between [npc.her] thighs. [npc.speech(There. I can get between them now.)]
[npc.Name] [npc.verb(hook)] a foot up and [npc.verb(bare)] [npc.herHim] to the water, a little breathless at how exposed the pose is. [npc.speech(Wide open. The water can get everywhere like this.)]
[npc.Name] [npc.verb(jam)] a foot up onto the edge and [npc.verb(hold)] it there, impatient to reach and be finished. [npc.speech(Leg up. Wash it. I am not holding this all day.)]
